meta.purpose: Emails for spontaneous candidature (unsolicited CV + short motivation) when no matching vacancy — or the HR inbox used on official calls.
meta.tip: Subject: Spontaneous application — [role / domain]. Attach CV + ½-page letter. Greek + English are commonly accepted; many HQs are in Athens but roles may be nationwide.

contacts.name: METAdrasi
contacts.note: Primary inbox for all vacancy calls; also usable for speculative CVs with a clear subject line.

contacts.name: Greek Council for Refugees (GCR)
contacts.note: General contact; prefer the Send CV flow on gcr.gr when a specific call is open.

contacts.name: SolidarityNow
contacts.note: Use exact vacancy subject when applying to a posted role; otherwise use a clear spontaneous-application subject line.

contacts.name: Caritas Athens
contacts.note: Also caritasref@caritasathens.gr for refugee-programme roles (Kapodistriou offices).

contacts.name: Caritas Athens (Refugee Program)
contacts.note: Secondary inbox listed on the Jobs page.

contacts.name: The HOME Project
contacts.note: Questions + applications; many roles also go through Workable.

contacts.name: ARSIS
contacts.note: Athens shelter calls (Oct 2026) ask for CV + interest letter to this address.

contacts.name: Lighthouse Relief
contacts.note: Rolling review for paid/intern roles. Volunteers use the separate Volunteer portal.

contacts.name: KMOP
contacts.note: Site invites unsolicited CVs when no opening matches.

contacts.name: ActionAid Hellas
contacts.note: Prefer Workable applications; no public generic HR mailbox found this pass.

contacts.name: IRC Hellas
contacts.note: Apply via IRC Workday — spontaneous email rarely accepted.

contacts.name: EPLO (European Public Law Organization)
contacts.note: Not in the 104 NGO registry (international org, Kolonaki). Senior Program Officer posted 21 Oct 2026.

contacts.name: Mission Anthropos (Αποστολή Άνθρωπος)
contacts.note: Athens-based; recent Programme Manager call used this inbox.
